source_note: M365 outlook_email_search. Inbox held 30 messages total (10 unread); all 30 paged and reviewed. The connector exposes no Outlook flag/importance bit (every result returns importance 'normal'), so is_flagged reflects unread state plus explicit deadline/RSVP/reply-requested markers in the subject or body, not the server flag. Marketing newsletters, receipts, and past-event notices excluded.
